generation.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Original vertical 2:3 fashion campaign studio photograph. Fictional adult Black female fashion model age 30, short sculpted natural hair, wearing a tailored vivid lemon-yellow blazer and large polished silver geometric hoop earrings. Bust-length portrait, torso in profile facing left, face turned towards camera with confident calm expression. Hands outside frame. Pale lilac seamless backdrop, glossy clean studio lighting, authentic detailed skin, precise tailoring and reflective silver, premium editorial photography. Head in upper quarter, shoulder and lapel occupy middle, lower quarter quiet lilac negative space for later typography. Original composition, no fruit decorations. No text, no logos, no watermark.
